unresolved_components.concise_supported_event: On June 27, 2026, five federal wildland firefighters were caught in a burnover while making an initial attack on the Knowles Fire in western Colorado.  Three firefighters died at the scene and two were injured.  The Interior Department’s account identifies the incident as the Knowles Fire burnover, not the “Snyder Fire” named in the original card.

unresolved_components.concise_supported_event: Nathan Matthews died on July 24, 2026, from burns sustained in the June 27 Knowles Fire burnover in Colorado.  His death brought the incident’s death toll to four; three firefighters had died at the scene and two others were injured on June 27.  The Interior Department announced the later death and said an accident investigation remained underway.
